capabilities: Keep Obsidian running in the Windows system tray when the window is closed
Start Obsidian hidden at login via an autostart entry
Restore the running window instead of showing the vault picker
Open today's quick note in a new tab via a global hotkey or tray menu
Restart or fully quit Obsidian from the tray menu
extras: Windows-only: the plugin does not enable on other systems. It instructs users to disable other tray plugins to avoid hotkey and close-behavior conflicts, and is installable via BRAT. The README documents all out-of-vault access (icon reading, Run-registry startup entry, global hotkey registration) and states it has no network access or telemetry. Global hotkeys are configured as raw accelerator strings such as CmdOrCtrl+Alt+O, not through Obsidian's hotkey settings.
problem: On Windows, closing Obsidian's window exits the app and relaunching can show the vault picker, so there is no way to keep it resident in the tray.
